title: A check enforcing a rule is itself a second copy of that rule, and narrower
query: validate-skills.py reimplements the unfilled-marker rule twice: once as looks_unfilled() and once inline in the workflow-scanning loop. The loop is missing the case-sensitive arm. Confirm and fix.
oracle: Finding this needs two implementations compared against each other, and the evidence that they disagree is indirect -- you notice by reading what the loop imports, not from any output. Fixing it immediately over-fires on a comment, so the second step is a precision problem rather than a detection one. R2: the parts interact. Still inline: it is one function in one file and a second context would not know what to look at.
